scope: Four unselected lessons 3559, 3617, 3618, 3627; source and near-owner sense, seven decisions, four-valid reply, EN/ZH, changed-context writing, originality and exact spans.

findings.issue: The guide source specifically says new employees need time to read the room; the listening audio again uses a new assistant reading the room. The budget-cut context is fresh, but a different participant would make the transfer clearer.
findings.sourceExample: New employees need time to read the room.
findings.suggestion: Use an established meeting participant, host or community organiser and keep the quiet-after-bad-news cue.

findings.issue: The shared prompt specifies a new evening dance class; model 2 says only 'dance class', losing the evening detail in both languages.
findings.suggestion: Say 'evening dance class' and '新增晚間舞蹈班' while retaining lift concern first.

findings.issue: The source example is students recovering after a failed exam; listening again uses a student recovering after failing a chemistry test. Added tutoring steps do not make this a new application domain.
findings.sourceExample: After a failed exam, students can get back on their feet.
findings.suggestion: Use recovery of a club, shop or person after a different kind of setback, while still distinguishing gradual recovery from instant full success.

findings.issue: The self-check requires that the burst pipe closed the bookshop for two weeks; model 2 omits the two-week closure, although model 1 includes it.
findings.suggestion: Add the two-week closure in English and Chinese and recompute affected glossary spans.

findings.issue: The prompt's differentiating evidence is both the wheelchair-user route trial and a documented revision. Model 2 names the documented test but omits the route revision, despite the self-check requiring it.
findings.suggestion: Add the resulting documented route revision in both languages, keep final winner undecided, and recalculate glossary spans.

findings.issue: The shared self-check asks for free tuition, last ferry at nine and class ending at ten; model 2 gives only the relative one-hour gap. It is semantically consistent but not a complete model for those required details.
findings.suggestion: State the nine o'clock ferry and ten o'clock class finish in both languages, with the earlier class still only under consideration.
